findings.expected: Provide a French banner image (e.g. banner-fr.png) with text "Un financement adapté à vos projets".
findings.description: French page uses the English banner image, which contains English text ("Financing that fits your plans. Competitive rates. Clear terms. No surprises.").
Footer is left in English on the French page.
Uses informal "tu" (tes) while the rest of the site (hero title "vous ressemble") uses "vous".
"Appliquer pour" is an anglicism (calque of "apply for"); Quebec French uses "demander un prêt" / "faire une demande de prêt".
Full name required error is in English on the French page; other fields show the French message.
Label uses "e-mail" while the validation message uses "adresse courriel"; inconsistent, and "courriel" is the Quebec standard.

findings.observed: Merci. Votre demande pour {montant} a été reçue.
findings.expected: Merci. Votre demande pour 12 500,00 $ a été reçue.
findings.description: The template variable {montant} is displayed literally instead of the amount.
"Pay later" is translated as "Pay now", the opposite meaning; it contradicts the help text "Premier paiement reporté de 30 jours".
Monthly payment uses English currency format on the French page (other French amounts use "12 500,00 $").

findings.observed: Aucune accusation pour un remboursement anticipé.
findings.expected: Aucuns frais ne s'appliquent en cas de remboursement anticipé.
findings.description: "charges" (fees) mistranslated as "accusation" (legal accusation).

findings.expected: Taux variable de 5,2 %, sous réserve de l'approbation du crédit.
findings.description: French drops the condition "subject to credit approval".

findings.expected: Use a French image showing "Taux variable : 5,2 %".
findings.description: French promo image states a fixed rate of 4.9%, contradicting the alt text, the rate shown (5,2 %) and the English image (variable 5.2%).
Close button translated as "Proche" (meaning "near/close by") instead of "Fermer".
Section heading left in English on the French dashboard.
The French dashboard link points to the English calculator, switching the user to English.

Transaction dates use US MM/DD/YYYY order in French (09/15/2026, 09/12/2026, 09/08/2026), which is ambiguous and not fr-CA (YYYY-MM-DD or "15 septembre 2026"); the long date on the application page used a French format.
In French, zero takes the singular form ("0 prêt actif"); the plural is used incorrectly.
"Balance" is an anglicism for account balance; French uses "solde".
A bank "statement" is a "relevé" in French; "déclaration" is a wrong calque (tax/legal declaration).
Due date identical to the English; inconsistent with the French long date format used on the application page and with the other dashboard dates.
The 404 page under /fr/ is the default English server page with no site header and no French text.
